from numpy import array


def transfert1():
    global M,L
    f1=open('source.txt','r')
    M=array([[int()]*10]*20)
    
    ch=f1.readline()
    ch=ch[:-1]
    i=0
    while ch!='':
        #traitement
        j=0
        while ch!='':
            p=ch.find(' ')
            M[i,j]=int(ch[:p])
            ch=ch[p+1:]
            j=j+1
        i=i+1
        ch=f1.readline()
        ch=ch[:-1]
    f1.close()
    L=i   #L represente le nombre de lignes

def tri_rapide(d,f,t):
    if f>d:
        m=(d+f)//2
        x=t[m] ; t[m]=t[d] ; t[d]=x
        p=d
        for i in range(d+1,f+1):
            if (t[i]<t[d]):
                p=p+1
                x=t[i]
                t[i]=t[p]
                t[p]=x
        x=t[p]
        t[p]=t[d]
        t[d]=x
        tri_rapide(d,p-1,t)
        tri_rapide(p+1,f,t)
    return t


def trier():
    t=array([int()]*L)
    for j in range(10):
        #transfert de la colonne vers le tableau
        for i in range (L):
            t[i]=M[i,j]
            
        
        #tri de tableau
            t=tri_rapide(0,L-1,t)
        
        #transfert du tableau vers la colonne
            for i in range(L):
                M[i,j]=t[i]

def transfert2():
    f2=open('resultat.txt','w')
    for i in range (L):      #dans chaque ligne
        ch=''
        for j in range(10):
            ch=ch+str(M[i,j])+' '
        ch=ch[:-1]
        f2.write(ch+'\n')
    f2.close()

def afficher():
    f2=open('resultat.txt','r')
    for i in range(L):
        ch=f2.readline()
        print(ch)
    f2.close()





#pp



transfert1()
trier()

transfert2=()
afficher()
